models.headline_note: vLLM comparisons ran both sides on the same Google Cloud TPU v6e-1: ours with Qwen3.8-27B-BQ8_R.bshj (26.94 GB, 8.01 bits per weight), vLLM TPU 0.32.0 with Qwen's FP8 weights (Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B-FP8), since Qwen's bf16 weights do not fit one chip. Measured 2026-10-28 (UTC). Every measurement and its method: [Results](#results).
